# SYNESIS_E154 — Error

## Description

SKOS integrity condition (2).

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the generated SKOS violates the integrity condition condition (2 case(s)); the file was not written.

  This is an exporter or project inconsistency, not an editorial choice: report it with the project files.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **SkosIntegrityViolation**: `block`, `condition`, `count`, `examples`
